## Introduction

```{r}
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# read in full list of 2026 ICD 10 codes from https://www.cms.gov/files/zip/2026-icd-10-pcs-codes-file.zip (7 character code and description)
icd10codes <- read_fwf(
  file = "data/2026-icd-10-pcs-codes-file/icd10pcs_codes_2026.txt",
  fwf_cols(
    code = c(1, 7),
    description = c(9, NA)  # skip 1 space between code and description
  ),
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)
head(icd10codes)
```

```{r}
# Function to get unique ICD codes from a single string
get_unique_ICD_from_string <- function(ICD_string) {
  # Split string by comma or space
  ICD_vector <- unlist(strsplit(ICD_string, split = "[, \n]+"))
  
  # Trim whitespace from each element
  ICD_vector <- trimws(ICD_vector)
  
  # Convert to character (in case of numeric-like codes)
  ICD_vector <- as.character(ICD_vector)
  
  # Return unique values
  unique(ICD_vector)
}
allcodes_unique <- get_unique_ICD_from_string(allcodes)

# Function to expand wildcard codes
expand_wildcards <- function(wildcard_string, master_codes) {
  wildcard_vector <- unlist(strsplit(wildcard_string, split = "[, \n]+"))
  wildcard_vector <- trimws(wildcard_vector)
  
  expanded <- map(wildcard_vector, function(pat) {
    regex_pat <- paste0("^", str_replace_all(pat, "x", ""))
    master_codes$code[str_detect(master_codes$code, regex_pat)]
  }) %>% unlist()
  
  unique(expanded)
}

wildcard_expanded <- expand_wildcards(wildcards, icd10codes)

combined_codes_unique <- sort(unique(c(allcodes_unique, wildcard_expanded)))
```
 
# Match codes to the descriptions:

 Columns for output: Number / Range 	Full Description* 	Procedure type	Approach

```{r}
# make into tibble for joining
combined_codes_df <- tibble(code = combined_codes_unique)

# join with icd10codes on the code
cardiacSGYlookup <- combined_codes_df %>%
  left_join(icd10codes, by = c("code")) %>%
  rename(`Number / Range` = code,
         `Full Description` = description) %>%
  mutate(
    `Procedure type` = case_when(
      str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Bypass Coronary Artery", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Coronary Artery Bypass Graft",
      str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Mitral Valve", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Mitral Valve repair/replacement",
      str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Aortic Valve", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Aortic Valve repair/replacement",
      str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Tricuspid Valve", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Tricuspid Valve repair/replacement",
      str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Pulmonary Valve", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Pulmonary Valve repair/replacement",
      TRUE ~ str_extract(`Full Description`, "^[A-Za-z]+")
    ),
    Approach = str_extract(`Full Description`,
                           "(Open Approach|Percutaneous Endoscopic Approach|Percutaneous Approach)"),
        Replacement = str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Replacement", ignore_case = TRUE))

  )

write.csv(cardiacSGYlookup, "output/ICD10_cardiacSGY_lookup.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Find Percutaneous Coronary Intervention codes
```{r}
PCI_codes <- icd10codes %>%
  filter(str_detect(description, regex("Dilation of Coronary Artery, ", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% 
  rename(`Number / Range` = code,
         `Full Description` = description) %>%
  mutate(Approach = str_extract(`Full Description`,
                           "(Open Approach|Percutaneous Endoscopic Approach|Percutaneous Approach)"),
         WithDevice = str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Device", ignore_case = TRUE)),
         DrugEluting = str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("Drug-eluting", ignore_case = TRUE)),
         Brachytherapy = str_detect(`Full Description`, regex("radioactive", ignore_case = TRUE))
  )

write.csv(PCI_codes, "output/ICD10_PCI_lookup.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

To prevent leading zeroes from being omitted when opening in excel => file:import:


While these codes are fresh on our minds, it would be beneficial for us to create 2 parallel lists:

    PCI with stents as treatment, for comparative effectiveness studies with CABG.
    Repeat revascularization as an outcome: Any CABG or PCI (including balloon angioplasty without stents, brachytherapy, etc.).
    
```{r}
stentasTreatment <- PCI_codes %>% filter(WithDevice == TRUE, Brachytherapy == FALSE) %>% pull(`Number / Range`) # include PCI with BMS or DES only
cat(paste(stentasTreatment, collapse = ", "))


revascasOutcome <- c(PCI_codes %>% pull(`Number / Range`), # include any PCI code and any CABG
                     cardiacSGYlookup %>% filter(`Procedure type` == "Coronary Artery Bypass Graft", Approach != "Percutaneous Approach") %>% pull(`Number / Range`)) # here, I include only CABG that was open or robotic (omitting the percutaneous ones)
cat(paste(revascasOutcome, collapse = ", "))

```

```{r}
codes_raw <- ("02HW3YZ, 02LW3DJ, 02VW3DZ, 027X3DZ, 027X3ZZ, 027W3DZ, 027W3ZZ, 02HW3DZ, 02QX3ZZ, 02QW3ZZ, 02VX3EZ, 02VX3FZ, 02VX3DZ, 02VW3EZ, 02VW3FZ, 02VW3CZ, 02VW3ZZ, 02UX3JZ, 02UW3JZ, 02CW3ZZ, 02CX3ZZ")

paste_codes_from_excel <- function(pasted_text) {
  # pasted_text: string you get from copy-pasting the Excel column
  clean <- pasted_text %>%
    # replace commas/tabs/semicolons with spaces, keep letters/digits only separated
    gsub("[,;\\t]", " ", .) %>%
    trimws()
  
  # split on any whitespace, then remove any non-alphanumeric chars around items
  codes <- unlist(strsplit(clean, "\\s+"))
  codes <- gsub("^['\"]+|['\".,;:+-]+$","", codes)  # drop leading/trailing quotes, commas, periods, etc.
  codes <- codes[codes != ""]                       # drop empties
  
  # return an R-ready quoted vector as a string
  paste0("c(", paste(shQuote(codes), collapse = ", "), ")")
}

paste_codes_from_excel(codes_raw)
```
